title: Database Systems Fundamentals
description: This course is designed for beginners who want to learn the basics of database systems, including data storage, retrieval, and manipulation. Students will learn how to design, create, and manage databases using MySQL.

modules.title: Database Fundamentals
modules.summary: Learn the basics of databases, including data storage and retrieval.

modules.title: Database Design
modules.summary: Design and create a database schema using entity relationship diagrams.

modules.title: Database Management Systems
modules.summary: Install and configure MySQL on different operating systems.

modules.title: SQL Fundamentals
modules.summary: Learn the basics of SQL, including queries, data definition, and data control.

modules.title: Data Retrieval and Manipulation
modules.summary: Learn how to retrieve and manipulate data using SQL queries and joins.
